title: RNA-Seq in vivo BA 30mg/kg (Chow) Diet
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Isolate total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract cellular RNA using the RNeasy® Mini Kit (Qiagen, catalog number 74104) according to the kit instructions.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Analyze and quantify the isolated RNA with an Agilent Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑Seq library
steps.instruction: Use 200 ng of total RNA to construct libraries with the NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit (New England Biolabs GmbH, Germany) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Evaluate library quality
steps.instruction: Assess the quantity and quality of the prepared libraries using an Agilent BioAnalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq instrument, aiming for approximately 35 million paired‑end 100 bp reads per library.
